projects.name: SAGE-EventKit
projects.description: Premium one-time-purchase web toolkit for creating and managing event materials.
projects.readme:
# SAGE EventKit

A premium web application for creating polished event materials and deliverables with a one-time purchase model for buyers.

## Product direction
- Serve individual customers and businesses
- Premium, practical templates and event workflows
- One-time purchase and activation, with no buyer subscription
- Secure purchase verification and license activation

## Status
Product strategy and implementation specification stage.

projects.name: SAGE-Mail-Intelligence
projects.description: SAGE email intelligence: read-only Gmail analysis, project monitoring, summaries, and approval-gated drafts.
projects.readme:
# SAGE Mail Intelligence

An email intelligence module for the SAGE ecosystem.

## Initial scope
- Read-only Gmail access for search and retrieval
- Project-related email classification and monitoring
- Thread summaries and action extraction
- Draft generation only; sending remains a separate user-approved action
- No automatic sending or destructive mailbox actions

## Security
Use least-privilege access, keep credentials out of source control, and require explicit approval before external actions.

projects.name: Altair-AC-Modding-Lab
projects.description: Research and tooling for modding the original Assassin's Creed game and building an engine-aware modding workflow.
projects.readme:
# Altair AC Modding Lab

A fan modding research project focused on extending the original Assassin's Creed experience using the original game's engine and available modding interfaces.

## Planned areas
- File and asset format research
- Mod packaging and compatibility tooling
- Configuration and runtime behavior documentation
- A custom workflow for organizing and testing mods

## Scope note
This is a modding project, not a claim to own or recreate Ubisoft technology. Keep proprietary assets and game binaries out of this repository; use lawful local game installations and original project files.
